description: Defines a Keyboard class for managing a virtual keyboard view, including key mappings, state toggling (shift, symbol), and key handling logic within an Android autofill keyboard app.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: Manages the virtual keyboard view, key mappings, states (shift, symbol), and key interactions.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns a label or symbol based on special key data strings.

methods.name: qwerty
methods.description: Creates a Keyboard instance with a predefined QWERTY key mapping.

methods.name: inflateKeyboardView
methods.description: Inflates the keyboard view layout and maps keys.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the keyboard state to default.

methods.name: mapKeys
methods.description: Maps key data to visual labels and click handlers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles key press actions, toggling states or passing data to AutofillImeService.
